**[P2] Include explicit validation in registration rejection cleanup**

`_validate_explicit_factories()` raises before entering the cleanup boundary. Passing a valid factory with an opted-in `on_registration_result` callback alongside an invalid entry therefore rejects the registration without notifying the valid factory. Constructor-owned resources that depend on the rejection callback remain allocated, unlike failures during environment resolution or exclusive-group validation. Materialize the explicit list before the `try`, validate it inside that boundary, and notify rejection on validation failure. Add a mixed valid/invalid list test asserting that the valid factory receives `False`.
